name: wboost
description: Work with wboost brand templates from Claude: list projects and their brand fonts and colours, find template variants, fill their text and image placeholders, preview the result and export the finished PNG.

token.title: wboost access token
token.description: Your personal wboost MCP token — it starts with wb_mcp_ and is shown once, when it is created. Ask a wboost operator to mint one for your account (see docs/mcp/connect.md). The token acts as YOU: it can never reach more than your own account already can.
